# Studio Franco

> Personal site of Nickolas Franco — an 18-year-old technologist from Minot, ND who builds AI tools, mods circuits, and documents the process.

Studio Franco is the personal portfolio, blog, and lab notebook of Nickolas Franco ("Nicko"). It is hand-coded in raw HTML and CSS (no frameworks, no templates), hosted on Cloudflare Pages, and built to share projects, experiments, and the mindset behind creative engineering.

- Site: https://studiofran.co
- Author: Nickolas Franco (Nicko)
- Location: Minot, North Dakota, USA
- Built with: HTML, CSS, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Email Routing
- Editor: Visual Studio Code
- Mirrors: https://itsnicko-github-io.pages.dev · https://itsnicko.github.io/studiofran.co

## About the author

Nickolas Franco is a self-taught builder, engineer, and creator. He works across software, AI, and hardware — including ESP32 and Raspberry Pi projects, Flask-based tools, Docker containers, and circuit-bending experiments. He embraces being a generalist: a jack of all trades who refuses to die average.

- Title: Technologist / Creative Builder
- Known for: AI tools, hardware hacking, circuit bending, self-directed learning
- Topics: Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, Flask, Docker, MicroPython, AI, Circuit Bending

## Blog posts

- [Who Are You When No One Is Watching](https://studiofran.co/blog/Who-are-You-When-No-One-is-Watching): On discipline, self-accountability, and the version of yourself you build when no one is watching.
- [I Don't Want to Die Average](https://studiofran.co/blog/I-Dont-Want-to-Die-Average): On being a jack of all trades, embracing versatility, and refusing to settle for average.
- [What I Actually Use Every Day (My EDC + Setup Breakdown)](https://studiofran.co/blog/My-EDC-Setup-Breakdown): A breakdown of the gear, tools, and setup an 18-year-old builder actually uses every day.
- [Why I Don't Learn Like School Taught Me](https://studiofran.co/blog/Why-I-Dont-Learn-Like-School-Taught-Me): Why self-directed learning by building, breaking, and doing beats memorization and classrooms.
- [New Website — This Ain't a Template](https://studiofran.co/blog/This-Ain't-a-Template): Why this site is built with raw HTML and CSS — no frameworks, no templates, no shortcuts.
- [Behind, but Not Outpaced](https://studiofran.co/blog/behind-but-not-outpaced): On feeling behind, chasing MIT, and refusing to stop building even when doubt creeps in.

## Philosophy

> I build things I want to see exist. Sometimes they break, I fix them or rebuild. No credentials, just curiosity, time, and trial/error.

The site documents the process, not just the polished output. Posts mix technical breakdowns with personal reflections on discipline, learning, and ambition.
